correctness.rationale: Condition on the first two iid draws and the remaining multinomial counts B_i. When the two match bin i, the increment to W_f is 2Δf(B_i)+Δ²f(B_i); when distinct i,j it is Δf(B_i)+Δf(B_j). Exchangeability of the pair collision indicators gives Cov(T,W_f)=binom(n,2)[(1-s2)sum p_i² EΔ²f(Bin(n-2,p_i))+2sum p_i(p_i-s2)EΔf(Bin(n-2,p_i))]. For convex f, the first term is nonnegative and strictly positive unless f affine (all positive p imply B_i full support). The second is Cov_{I~p}(p_I,g(p_I)) with nondecreasing g by binomial coupling, hence >=0. Uniform p cancels this covariance, and the binomial second difference yields a quadratic sign polynomial P_{n,m}(r), plus exact r=0 and r=1 cases. I independently enumerated all n=5, three-category occupancy vectors with p=(1/2,1/3,1/6) for f(k)=binom(k,2): Cov(T,W_f)=535/162>0. Analytic proof, not finite enumeration, controls all parameters.

Uniform frequency counts show two exact sign transitions and a sharp zero at n=2m for singletons, meaningful inference invariants rather than arbitrary examples.
